nodes.label: Decision: Tauri 2 + Rust + React/TS stack
nodes.rationale: ~10MB binary vs ~150MB Electron, faster startup, user already works with Tauri elsewhere; accepted cost: PTY and integrations must be rewritten in Rust.

nodes.label: Decision: v1 covers only the observable free core
nodes.rationale: The only feature set observable on the free-tier reference install; specifying PRO features would mean inventing behavior.

nodes.label: Decision: no monetization layer in the clone
nodes.rationale: The clone has no commercial product behind it, so everything built is unlocked.

nodes.label: Decision: Kanban in a separate window, like the reference product
nodes.rationale: Observed and defensible behavior: the board is a reading/management surface distinct from terminal work.

nodes.label: Decision: MCP server as separate sidecar, not embedded
nodes.rationale: The CLI agent spawns MCP servers as a stdio subprocess, and an already-running app cannot be that subprocess.

nodes.label: Decision: sidecar talks to app via local IPC, never writes DB directly
nodes.rationale: The app must own the write path to push task_changed to windows; direct sidecar writes would make the <1s Kanban reflection requirement impossible.

nodes.label: Decision: PTY output via tauri::ipc::Channel with 16ms aggregation
nodes.rationale: Tauri docs recommend Channel for streaming with explicit rate limiting; per-chunk emit collapses the UI under heavy output.

nodes.label: Decision: test-phase rule enforced by absent state-machine edge
nodes.rationale: A transition that does not exist cannot be forgotten; an if-check can.

nodes.label: Decision: no card dragging between columns in v1
nodes.rationale: Not observed in the original and conflicts with the state machine — dragging to Completed would skip the test phase.

nodes.label: Decision: MCP tool contract frozen from global CLAUDE.md, unvalidated
nodes.rationale: User's choice at triage 001: unblocks T0 and 22 M2 tasks immediately, accepting the risk that a diverging tool name silently breaks the user's existing prompts.

nodes.label: Decision: Status: Draft in a tasks.md blocks automated execution
nodes.rationale: Draft means "not yet reviewed by the maintainer", not "rough draft"; spec-loop only executes a feature whose tasks.md is In Progress.

nodes.label: Decision: a Verify that requires the running app is uat-agent; no two uat-agent tasks run in parallel
nodes.rationale: The spec's [P] guards against file collisions, not against two instances fighting over the same app window, DB and PTY.

nodes.label: Decision: settings-shell born as a new feature
nodes.rationale: User's choice answering where AgentPanel/ProjectsPanel/StatusesPanel/UpdateSettings should live: a new feature rather than folding into agent-selection; architecture decided jointly (second Tauri window, no react-router, label branch in main.tsx).

nodes.label: Decision: multi-terminal/TERM-06 absorbs terminal-statuses/STAT-07 (revoked)
nodes.rationale: Both specs described the same rule (manual terminal rename wins over the agent); TERM-06 becomes sole owner since it is broader (also covers branch/git display) and lives in the feature that already owns TerminalHeader.

nodes.label: Decision: populate AGENTS.md with the project's real conventions
nodes.rationale: Closes the gap where CLAUDE.md and spec-driven-changes.md cited AGENTS.md as the source of convention while it had 0 bytes since creation.

nodes.label: Finding: all 4 settings panels exist and are tested but unreachable — no Settings window/route anywhere
nodes.rationale: AgentPanel/ProjectsPanel/StatusesPanel/UpdateSettings are never imported outside their own test files; no router or window-switch mechanism mounts any of them.

nodes.label: Finding: App.tsx::handleCreate receives agentId but never uses it
nodes.rationale: The parameter is prefixed with _ (unused convention) and never reaches pty_spawn, so per-session agent override (AGT-03) stays broken even if the Settings gap is fixed.

nodes.label: Finding: emit_task_changed emits an empty payload, breaking useTaskStore at runtime
nodes.rationale: ipc/server.rs::emit_task_changed sends app.emit("task_changed", ()) by design ("a nudge, not data transport"), but useTaskStore.ts consumes event.payload.op/.task/.taskId without a null guard, so KAN-02 real-time update is broken in practice.

nodes.label: Finding: IpcServer is never started by the real app — sidecar cannot connect in production
nodes.rationale: grep for IpcServer in src-tauri/src/lib.rs returns nothing; all T5/T6/T7 tests pass only against a test-instantiated IpcServer, never the real app.

nodes.label: Finding: v0.1.1 release actually shipped, published outside this skill
nodes.rationale: origin/master reached 5c81ed2 (tag v0.1.1); CI and Release workflows both ran green via workflow_dispatch, resolving in practice the T2/T21 blockage that release-distribution/tasks.md registered.

nodes.label: Decision: SwarmDeck stops being described as a clone/reverse-engineering of a named product
nodes.rationale: Revokes the 28/07/2026 AD; PROJECT.md, README.md, UI-INVENTORY.md and provenance notes drop the reference product's proper name while preserving why each requirement exists.

nodes.label: Live UI observation: project/agent picker flow and session restoration (4 new screens)
nodes.rationale: 4 real screenshots led to 5 joint decisions: project color becomes an automatic suggestion with manual override; Turbo Mode confirmed observed but still excluded from scope; Resume Session enters v1 core (AGT-06); git init is local-only (PROJ-09); connecting a GitHub account is deferred.

hyperedges.label: Recurring pattern: gate green but component never mounted (Settings, App.tsx, Kanban route)
